name: AICommit
description:
AI-generated commit messages for JetBrains IDEs. Reads your staged diff and writes a clear commit message in one click — from the commit dialog or the AI Commit tool window.

Bring your own provider, or run fully offline

  • OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI, DeepSeek
  • Ollama — one-click local setup, so your code never leaves your machine
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoints — save multiple profiles and switch between them from the tool window

Built for real repositories

  • Parallel processing for changesets with many files
  • DeepSeek Thinking Mode with live reasoning progress — reasoning content is never inserted into your commit, stored in history, or sent in telemetry
  • Per-project message history, persisted across sessions
  • Custom prompts and adjustable generation parameters
  • Interface in English, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어

Privacy

No code and no commit messages are collected. Telemetry is opt-out with a full disclosure in Settings → About. With Ollama, nothing leaves your machine at all.

Actively maintained

Published by a JetBrains Marketplace verified vendor, with regular releases — see the changelog for what shipped most recently.

docText:
AICommit generates commit messages from your staged Git diff in JetBrains IDEs. Use it from the Commit dialog or the AI Commit tool window. It does not add an editor popup, and it does not optimize code, generate documentation, convert code, or translate files.

  1. Install AICommit from the JetBrains Marketplace, then restart the IDE if prompted.
  2. Configure a provider under Settings / Preferences → Tools → AI Commit → Providers. Bring your own key for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI, DeepSeek, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. For fully local use, choose Ollama so your code never leaves your machine.
  3. Stage your changes, then generate a message in either place:
    • Open the Commit dialog and use the AI Commit action, or
    • Open View → Tool Windows → AI Commit and click Generate.
  4. Review the message, edit if needed, and commit as usual.

No code and no commit messages are collected. Telemetry is opt-out with a full disclosure in Settings → About. With Ollama, nothing leaves your machine at all.
